'''Kalevala Spaceworks''' was a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufacturing company based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalevala/Legends|Kalevala]],<ref name="TCWIV" /> located in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]' [[Mandalore sector/Legends|Mandalore sector]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> Kalevala Spaceworks constructed the luxury [[Passenger liner/Legends|starliner]] known as the [[Coronet/Legends|''Coronet'']] for [[Duchess/Legends|Duchess]] [[Satine Kryze/Legends|Satine Kryze]] of the [[New Mandalorians/Legends|New Mandalorians]], utilizing high quality materials from across Mandalorian [[Realspace/Legends|space]].<ref name="TCWIV" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kalevala Spaceworks was first introduced to ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series reference book, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Official Episode Guide Series 1 & 2]]'', [[Author/Legends|authored]] by [[Jason Fry]] and published [[September 30]], [[2010]]. It was later mentioned in Fry's subsequent reference book for the television series, ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars: Incredible Vehicles]]'', released a year later in [[2011]].
